title.suggested: Allen Arrives in New Orleans with the St. Louis Delegation

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported from New Orleans that Tom Allen and Tom Kelly, "the prize ring veterans," arrived with a large St. Louis delegation for the championship fights; Allen was very positive Sullivan would win.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, September 4, 1892, page 3. Dispatch from New Orleans dated September 3.

facts.fact: Allen traveled from St. Louis to New Orleans with a large St. Louis sporting delegation, including Tom Kelly and his old backer Fred Watkins, for the Sullivan-Corbett, Myer-McAuliffe and Dixon-Skelly fights
Allen was very positive that John L. Sullivan would beat Corbett

notes: Fred Watkins described as 'Allen's old backer'. Related to the existing (unnumbered, 000) fact about Allen returning from a New Orleans fight in early September 1892.
